title: Model Checkpoints and Data for SAR-Flood-Surrogate
description: Pre-trained model weights, patch assignments, and validation predictions for the SAR-constrained flood inundation surrogate modelling project. Study event: July 2023 Daqinghe River flood, North China Plain. This archive includes: (1) Three pre-trained U-Net models (Vanilla 6ch, ResNet34 6ch, Vanilla 7ch), (2) Patch assignment file for 1,267 training and 80 validation patches, (3) Validation prediction arrays. Code available at https://github.com/kaedez-hydro/SAR-Flood-Surrogate
